description: .   Application of advanced storytelling, shooting, and editing techniques for digital storytelling within the context of agriculture and life sciences; building of visual narratives using a combination of still images, HD video, ambient audio, and natural voices that appeal to scientific and non-scientific audiences; application of the journalistic standards of truth, fairness and accuracy with the tools and techniques of digital storytelling to tell compelling stories in the agriculture and life sciences.
name: Digital Storytelling in Agriculture and Life Sciences II
